Programs, Applying and Deadlines
Here you can find the graduate and professional programs currently offered at UIC. Select a program to view relevant application deadlines and links to the application, the program's website and the catalog listing.
Looking to apply for Fall 2027, Spring 2028 or Summer 2028?
Our Fall 2027+ applications are expected to open on August 1, 2026 (though some professional programs will open earlier during the summer).
Sign up here to receive a message in August when the application opens!
Applying
To create a new application, please enter your program of interest into the search box below or choose one of the degree categories to select from the list. Click the program name, review the deadline information, and select the Apply link found within the informational section of the program when you're ready to start a New application.
If you've already started the application, click here to log in to continue completing your application.
Deadlines
For most non-online programs, there are separate application submission deadlines for Domestic and International applicants. Optional earlier Priority, Recommended, Fellowship or Funding dates may be noted for some programs, and would apply for both Domestic and International applicants.

NOTICE OF AVAILABILITY OF THE UIC ANNUAL SECURITY AND FIRE SAFETY REPORT
The University of Illinois at Chicago is pleased to share the Annual Security & Fire Safety Report with all prospective students. The report contains information regarding campus security and personal safety including topics such as: crime prevention, public safety authority, crime reporting policies, fire safety, disciplinary procedures, and fire statistics in UIC residential facilities and crime statistics for the three previous calendar years. The full text of this report is available online at ready.uic.edu. If you would like to receive a copy on paper, visit the Office of Preparedness & Response, located at 1140 South Paulina Street, Suite 109, Chicago, IL 60612.
